x402_router_adapter_operations_execution.name: x402_router_adapter_operations_execution_signed_fields_check
x402_router_adapter_operations_execution.value:
"x402_router_adapter_operations"."kind" <> 'execution' or (
        (
          "x402_router_adapter_operations"."status" = 'claimed'
          and "x402_router_adapter_operations"."signer_nonce" is null
          and "x402_router_adapter_operations"."transaction_hash" is null
          and "x402_router_adapter_operations"."payload_ciphertext" is null
        )
        or (
          "x402_router_adapter_operations"."status" = 'manual_intervention'
          and (
            "x402_router_adapter_operations"."signer_nonce" is null
            or (
              "x402_router_adapter_operations"."signer_nonce" is not null
              and "x402_router_adapter_operations"."transaction_hash" is not null
            )
          )
        )
        or (
          "x402_router_adapter_operations"."status" in (
            'signed',
            'submitted',
            'confirmed_success',
            'confirmed_failure'
          )
          and "x402_router_adapter_operations"."signer_nonce" is not null
          and "x402_router_adapter_operations"."transaction_hash" is not null
        )
      )

x402_router_support_challenges_authority.name: x402_router_support_challenges_authority_check
x402_router_support_challenges_authority.value:
(
          "x402_router_support_challenges"."action" in ('plan_create', 'plan_retire')
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."authority_mode" is not null
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."authority" is not null
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."authority" = lower(btrim("x402_router_support_challenges"."authority"))
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."authority" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{40}$'
        ) or (
          "x402_router_support_challenges"."action" in ('subscription_create', 'subscription_cancel')
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."authority_mode" is null
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."authority" is null
        )

x402_router_support_challenges_consumed_.name: x402_router_support_challenges_consumed_check
x402_router_support_challenges_consumed_.value:
(
          "x402_router_support_challenges"."consumed_at" is null
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."signature_hash" is null
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."verified_block" is null
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."verified_block_hash" is null
        ) or (
          "x402_router_support_challenges"."consumed_at" is not null
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."signature_hash" is not null
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."signature_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."verified_block" is not null
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."verified_block" >= 0
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."verified_block_hash" is not null
          and "x402_router_support_challenges"."verified_block_hash" ~ '^0x[0-9a-f]{64}$'
        )

x402_router_support_invoices_cancelled_c.name: x402_router_support_invoices_cancelled_check
x402_router_support_invoices_cancelled_c.value:
(
          "x402_router_support_invoices"."status" = 'open'
          and "x402_router_support_invoices"."cancelled_at" is null
        ) or (
          "x402_router_support_invoices"."status" = 'cancelled'
          and "x402_router_support_invoices"."cancelled_at" is not null
        )

x402_router_support_plans_retired_check.name: x402_router_support_plans_retired_check
x402_router_support_plans_retired_check.value:
(
          "x402_router_support_plans"."status" = 'active'
          and "x402_router_support_plans"."retired_at" is null
        ) or (
          "x402_router_support_plans"."status" = 'retired'
          and "x402_router_support_plans"."retired_at" is not null
        )

x402_router_support_subscriptions_cancel.name: x402_router_support_subscriptions_cancelled_check
x402_router_support_subscriptions_cancel.value:
(
          "x402_router_support_subscriptions"."status" = 'active'
          and "x402_router_support_subscriptions"."cancelled_at" is null
        ) or (
          "x402_router_support_subscriptions"."status" = 'cancelled'
          and "x402_router_support_subscriptions"."cancelled_at" is not null
        )
